work_handoff.title: N22｜People in the Flow — Ning Observational POV｜Candidate 01
requirements: Generate exactly one N22 Candidate 01 PNG and stop for Product Owner review.
9:16 vertical cinematic audio-comic still.
Primary read = an observed fragment of a larger mixed group; secondary read = some individuals may matter later.
N22 is not a full-cohort scale shot and not a four-character cast shot.
Tier 1 comparatively readable identities: Su Xiaoxiao and Liao Jian.
Tier 2 secondary/partial identities: Wen Qingya and Guang Yong.
Additional unnamed participants may appear as cropped shoulders, partial bodies, rear-facing, side-facing, shadowed or deeper soft-focus figures.
No hard visible-person count and no requirement that all four named faces be fully visible simultaneously.
Global flow generally deeper into the castle; local states must be asynchronous and non-choreographed.
Allow uneven spacing, differing body angles, natural overlap, partial occlusion, one walking, one slowing, one briefly looking around, or one partially stopped.
Avoid single-file queue, shoulder-to-shoulder row, symmetrical V/arc, shared stride phase, all heads turned the same way, all faces toward camera, cast photo or team poster.
REFERENCE ORDER DOES NOT EQUAL SCREEN POSITION, LEFT/RIGHT ORDER, BLOCKING ORDER OR PROMINENCE.
Ning-attributed POV may be conveyed through edit continuity alone; an optional small cropped soft shoulder/back edge cue is allowed only if it does not damage composition.
Ning is not a required visible subject.
Scene remains CASTLE_ENTRANCE → INTERIOR TRANSITION ZONE.
Architecture must remain off-axis, subordinate and supporting rather than spectacular.
AST_IMG_000052 controls scene identity, open-door state and stable architectural/material facts, not exact camera or centered composition.

Continue N20's written look contract: dim warm amber/tungsten practical light, low-key exposure, natural skin, restrained saturation, moderate cinematic contrast, textured dark clothing/stone, no direct exterior sunlight flooding floor or bodies, limited transition-zone scale, no full hall establishment.
Neil should preferably be absent and must not become a subject; N23 owns Neil's directional turn.
Jun Luyuan is not required and must not leak into the shot as an unintended subject.
The four Character Reference Sheets control identity only. Do not copy their panel positions, poses, facing directions, spacing or left-right arrangement.
exclusions: four named characters lined up together
all four named characters equally clear
fixed left-to-right order derived from reference order
